best_parts: node open_t2 and contrast_t2: feedback names the tempting model ('the site feels familiar', 'that artery seems to fit') before the refutation, and the sure_note re-reads the question wording
node contrast: the pairing probe carries the merged artery-swap trap (TR1 with TR2 artery), so the wall and the artery are tested together
node open_hint: the hint points at what lies behind each wall without naming the answer
flaws: node gas: the key is the only hedged option ('though others exist') while both traps are absolute ('always', 'until proven otherwise'), so the key is findable by form (DP1)
node gas_t1 and gas_t2: both traps are the same error (E4, rule for frequency), so the path does not separate two wrong models (R9)
whole segment: no agency, skip or second-explanation node after a miss; a miss only returns to the same question (R5)

best_parts: node gate_t1 -> teach_site: an agency 'Show me why' route gives a second explanation (window device) after a miss, the only true remediation branch among the three
node gate_ok: a 'Skip the teaching' fast lane that still reaches the frequency probe, so experts keep O1 and O2 on their path
node pair_t2: the left gastric artery distractor is the merged TR2 artery-swap, and its feedback names the tempting neighbour before refuting it
flaws: node pn: the key ('the picture still decides') is the only hedged option against two absolute traps ('always... theatre', 'the one cause'), so the key is guessable by form (DP1)
node pn_t1 and pn_t2: both traps carry the same E4 frequency-to-rule error, so the path does not separate two wrong models (R9)
node pn_ok and pn_t1: the O2 claim K66 and the Chilaiditi-adjacent teaching are absent on the main path, so the free-gas objective rests on K3 alone (R3)

best_parts: node retest: a 60-year-old with a recent laparoscopy turns the frequency trap into a real management decision (read with history versus theatre now), the strongest clinical moment in the three
node case: the probe opens with 'Think perforation' and a bolded target, then the two wall traps are each named with the tempting model in feedback
node retest_t3 and gas_t3: the 'most common' qualifier is re-tested in a second form after the first, so TR3 is met twice in the segment
flaws: node gas: a two-real-option probe (key versus one trap, 'always... so theatre'), and the key is the longest option and the only one without an absolute word, so it is findable by form (DP1, DP2)
whole segment: the artery-swap (merged TR2) and the wall-outcome pairing are never probed, so O1's artery part is taught only in feedback (R3)
whole segment: no agency, skip or second-explanation node; a miss gets only 'Try again' to the same question (R5)

merge_ideas: b's agency route to teach_site and skip lane from gate_ok, with a's contrast probe (artery-swap as a second form of TR1) and a's open_t2 tempting-then-refute feedback
c's laparoscopy retest as a third gas probe after a's 'until proven otherwise' trap, so TR3 is met in two forms with a real management decision
all three: rewrite the key on each probe to share the traps' hedging or absolutes (for example make every option absolute or none), so the key is not findable by form
